r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: Fowler pass recorded at .agent-work/issue-308/g5-review/fowler-pass.json; verify_fowler_pass.py exit 0 (smells=12, flagged=['duplicated-code','shotgun-surgery'], overridden=['long-method','speculative-generality'], absent=8). r7-own-enumeration.title: Independent enumeration of lesson read-intake sites
r7-own-enumeration.imperative: HUNTED CLASS 1. Build an INDEPENDENT enumeration of live lesson read-intake sites by a route the acceptance guard does not use (different patterns, wider scope than skills/, semantic read of every file mentioning the bank). Assert the count you looped over, derived from a command. Compare against the guard's enumeration. Treat the guard's green as a hypothesis: prove it could have gone red.
r7-own-enumeration.finding: MY ENUMERATION: 34 files, derived from `git grep -lIiE 'lessons|playbook|Active section' -- skills/ docs/agents/ scripts/ README.md CLAUDE.md '*.md' ':!.agent-work' ':!episodes' ':!docs/superpowers' ':!notes-*.md' ':!tests' | sort | wc -l` -> 34. Different route on all three axes: semantic keys (never 'LESSONS.md'), wider scope (docs/, scripts/, repo root, not just skills/), no allowlist short-circuit. Guard's route enumerates 10. I read the lessons-relevant lines of all 34 and classified each. RESULT: ZERO surviving live-agent read-intake sites. Corroborating null: `git grep -nIi 'Active section' -- skills/ docs/ scripts/ README.md SKILL_INDEX.md CLAUDE.md` returns NOTHING - the phrase is gone from the live corpus. skills/_shared/ (the doctrine bundled into EVERY skill) has zero 'lessons' hits. No hook injects a digest (grep -rniE 'lessons' scripts/hooks/ -> empty). FALSIFIABILITY (the guard's green could have gone red): 4 mutants, each appended then restored byte-exact. M1 (read sentence into skills/workbench/templates/WORKFLOW_CLOSEOUT.template.md) -> guard exit 1 RED. So the guard is NOT vacuous. But M2 (same sentence into docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, live doctrine outside skills/) -> exit 0 GREEN, BLIND. M3 (same sentence into the ALLOWLISTED skills/lessons-auditor/SKILL.md; the allowlist short-circuits before any marker runs) -> exit 0 GREEN, BLIND. M4 ('read the Active entries of the curated lessons playbook under .agent-work/' into skills/commander-delegated/SKILL.md, never spelling LESSONS.md so it is never enumerated) -> exit 0 GREEN, BLIND. OBSERVATION (guard debt, not a defect in this change): the guard's green covers only in-skills/, non-allowlisted, file-name-spelling intake. My independent pass covered the three blind spots and found nothing living in them.

r8-template-semantics.title: Templates semantically coherent, not merely parseable
r8-template-semantics.imperative: HUNTED CLASS 2. r8-template-semantics.finding: Read all six edited prose sites end to end, plus the surrounding paragraph, plus every pre/postcondition on the two edited spine steps. No dangling conjunction, no orphaned object, no postcondition referring to the removed read. Checked specifically: COMMANDER_SPINE context c1 ('orchestrator context, glossary, engine config loaded; current map read...') names no lessons - it was already lessons-free, so no c1-promises-what-the-imperative-no-longer-does break; c2 is the map orientation contract, untouched. AGENT_GUIDE bullet reads as a complete sentence pair and now states the positive rule ('a staging bank an audit drains, not planning input for a live run'). Both JSON templates json.load clean and un-reflowed. TRIAGE CANDIDATE (fenced, not a defect of this gate): the COMMANDER_SPINE **feedback** imperative - which the handoff explicitly fenced as writer-side - still carries language that presupposed the read this gate removed: 'the playbook holds open problems you are carrying forward', 'a lesson goes in the bank ONLY because it needs to be re-observed to be understood', 'every add must carry a bank_reason saying what re-observation will clarify', and the confirm/disconfirm ops (the deleted context sentence was the other half: 'note any lesson this run's evidence contradicts (it becomes a disconfirm op at the feedback step)'). With the read cut, no live agent re-observes a banked lesson; only the auditor drains it. Reachable and editable, but out of this gate's fenced scope.

r11-tests-can-fail.title: Reworked episode-capture tests can still go red
r11-tests-can-fail.imperative: By CONSTRUCTION: mutate the production code the reworked durable-root tests cover and confirm they fail. A check that cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that passed.
r11-tests-can-fail.finding: The reworked tests still guard, established by construction with 3 mutants, each restored byte-exact (sha256 re-checked after every restore; git status --porcelain -- scripts/ tests/ skills/ docs/ empty afterwards). Baseline: the three RootResolution durable tests = '3 passed in 0.75s'. MUT-A - the exact silent trap the tests exist for: in scripts/episode_capture.py swap 'from agent_work_root import durable_root' for 'import durable_agent_work as durable_root' -> '3 failed in 0.91s'. All three killed it, including the reworked synthetic-fixture one. MUT-B - the other documented trap, resolve durable from base_dir instead of the repo root ('durable': durable_root(Path(base_dir) if base_dir else repo)) -> '3 failed in 0.78s'. MUT-C - re-add the removed declaration {'root':'durable','path':'.agent-work/LESSONS.md'} to COMMANDER_SPINE context_refs -> tests/test_context_manifest.py::CommanderSpineDeclaration + the reworked episode test = '2 failed, 4 passed' (baseline '6 passed, 5 subtests passed'). So the rework did NOT hollow the guard: the synthetic fixture kills the same mutants the shipped fixture did, and the added assertion that the corpus ships zero durable declarations makes a re-added one visible rather than silently changing what the test exercises.

consolidation.summary: ACCEPT / APPROVE. 0 blockers, 3 observations, 4 triage candidates. All three hunted classes were SEARCHED FOR and NOT FOUND. Class 1: built an independent 34-file enumeration by a different route (semantic keys never naming LESSONS.md, scope wider than skills/, no allowlist short-circuit) vs the guard's 10; read all 34; zero surviving live-agent read-intake sites. Corroborating nulls: 'Active section' returns nothing across the live corpus, skills/_shared/ has zero lessons hits, no hook injects a digest, and zero durable declarations remain corpus-wide. Guard falsifiability established: M1 (read sentence into an in-scope non-allowlisted skills file) drove it RED, so the green is not vacuous - but M2 (outside skills/), M3 (allowlisted file, allowlist short-circuits before markers), and M4 (never spells LESSONS.md, so never enumerated) each left it GREEN, bounding what the green means. I swept all three blind spots by hand; clean. Class 2: read every edited imperative end to end plus every pre/postcondition on both edited spine steps; no dangling clause, no orphaned postcondition. One fenced follow-on (feedback-step re-observation language) filed as tc2. Class 3: both invariants halves intact, LAUNCH_ORDER's parenthetical byte-identical, charter-lite carrier proven untouched (0 +/- lines). Writer verified by content not count - and the handoff's count was wrong: 6 occurrences before, 4 after, not 5/3 - then driven end to end on a scratch copy (add landed, tick 40->41, real bank untouched). Reworked tests proven able to fail: 3 mutants, all killed, all restored byte-exact. Suite observed by me with python: 1621 passed, 2 skipped, 541 subtests in 416s. Fowler rail exit 0 (12 smells, 2 flagged, 2 overridden with logged standards). REVIEW_RESULT at .agent-work/issue-308/crew-handoffs/g5-review-result.md.

triage_candidates.statement: Harden .agent-work/issue-308/checks/lesson_intake_is_cut.py (or its successor) against three demonstrated blind spots: (a) it only scans skills/, so a read-intake sentence added to docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md passes green; (b) an ALLOWLIST hit short-circuits before any READ_MARKER runs, so a read instruction added to skills/lessons-auditor/SKILL.md passes green - the allowlist should exempt the specific known reference, not the whole file; (c) the enumeration is keyed on the literal 'LESSONS.md', so a site phrased 'the curated lessons playbook under .agent-work/' is never enumerated. All three proven by mutants that left the guard at exit 0.

The COMMANDER_SPINE feedback imperative still carries re-observation language that presupposed the context-step read #308 removed: 'the playbook holds open problems you are carrying forward', 'a lesson goes in the bank ONLY because it needs to be re-observed to be understood', the bank_reason requirement 'saying what re-observation will clarify', and the confirm/disconfirm ops whose observing half lived in the deleted context sentence. With the read cut, no live agent re-observes a banked lesson - only the auditor drains it. Decide whether that language is rewritten for the audit-drain model or the ops retire with the playbook.

docs/RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_DESIGN.md:118 still records 'Spine context step gains a read: load LESSONS.md (and skim undigested log entries) before understand/plan', and :171 proposes a SessionStart hook that would 'inject the LESSONS.md digest so even ad-hoc non-Commander sessions inherit lessons'. Neither is a live-agent instruction (it is a design-rationale doc; no hook implements it - grep -rniE 'lessons' scripts/hooks/ is empty), so neither is a read-intake site. But both are now stale as current-state claims and the hook proposal would reintroduce intake if anyone built it.

tests/test_episode_capture.py spells the synthetic durable fixture literal '.agent-work/synthetic-durable.md' 4 times (grep -c -> 4) with the {root,path,required} entry dict written out twice. A module-level constant would let the root-resolution tests share one fixture. Cosmetic.
